headline: 18 Michigan deals, $30.7M raised — led by Sun Communities Inc

top_deals.summary: Sun Communities Inc (SUI) reported completing an acquisition or disposition of assets; filing cites a figure of ~$1.1B.
RPM Ventures Astro I, LP, an Ann Arbor-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $100M raise; $0 sold.
Genesis Fund Corp, a Grosse Ile-based commercial real estate company, filed a $50M equity offering under Rule 506(c); $100K sold to 1 investor. (Amended filing.)
EIG14T Ehw Fund Xvii LLC, a Berkley-based commercial real estate company, filed a $15.7M equity offering under Rule 506(c); $13M sold to 70 investors.
Parallel Robotics, Inc., an Ann Arbor-based technology company, filed a $11.3M equity and convertible note offering under Rule 506(b); $7.3M sold to 32 investors.

new_funds.summary: RPM Ventures Astro I, LP, an Ann Arbor-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $100M raise; $0 sold.
Hantz Ventures - SPV II LLC, a Southfield-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $5.7M raise; $5.7M sold to 47 investors.
Aptera Capital Onshore Fund LP, a Grosse Pointe Woods-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $2.8M sold to 9 investors. (Amended filing.)

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $30.7M sold across 10 Form D filings this week, down 51% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Genesis Fund Corp (Grosse Ile, Commercial) targeting $50M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
Sun Communities Inc (SUI) closed a transaction. It was one of 5 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan real estate assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

5 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $12.7M raised so far — led by RPM Ventures Astro I, LP (Venture Capital Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
